source_text.Q-1011: LOW (INV-10 family), S3, ISS-1026 follow-up, GH #2311, local ISS-1029 (queue issue_ref ISS-1011 clashes with local ISS-1011). Six acceptance criteria in queue task 1011.

task.description: WF-03 Steps 0.5+1+2 for Q-1011 / GH #2311 / ISS-1029: registry lookup, run the repro, root cause, fix design for the three promotion read routes (stored-tenant check), list decision, test update list, draft docs/issues/ISS-1029.yaml. Design only; no lib/ code.

result.summary:
DIAGNOSIS (code path confirmed by reading every involved function; the dynamic repro could NOT be run here, see REPRO STATUS). The gap is real and unguarded. In lib/letflow/routers/promotions.ex the three read handlers never look at the stored plan's source_tenant_id / target_tenant_id: handle_get_assertion_run (L487) calls PromotionReviewStore.get_review/2 and, on {:ok, _}, returns Definitions.get_latest_assertion_run (run status, counts, failing_assertion_ids); handle_context (L526) calls get_review/2 and renders review_context_map/2 (status, requested_by, def_type, def_id, created_at, row_version; serialised_plan is only SHAPED by shape_plan/2 for a non-operator, ISS-1021/1023, never refused); handle_list_reviews (L1157) calls PromotionReviewStore.list_reviews/2 (lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_review_store.ex L239) and renders every row in the caller's schema. The write handlers (approve L572, reject L613, apply L653, run-assertions L788) call stored_tenants_authorized?/3 (L678) first and answer Response.not_found/1 for a foreign-named, malformed or legacy plan. The authz_get macros (L225-L260) only gate :PromotionsRead; the per-review decision is missing. Same root cause as ISS-1026 (check added to writes only), on the read side. Why no test caught it: ISS-1021/1023 tests deliberately asserted 200 plus shaped bodies for foreign-named reviews (shaping was the control), and ISS-1026's repro covered writes only.

REPRO STATUS: test/letflow/routers/promotion_read_stored_ids_test.exs (HEAD d2e08c67b) was run as `LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5499 MIX_ENV=test mix test <file>` under the machine mutex at 2026-10-13T11:27:46Z and could not start: `tcp connect (localhost:5499): connection refused`, `** (Mix) The database for Letflow.Repo couldn't be created: killed`. Environment: Docker daemon not running (dockerDesktopLinuxEngine pipe missing), nothing listening on 5432/5462/5499, Windows service postgresql-x64-17 is Stopped and Start-Service is denied (no admin). So there is NO measured failure to quote. Static expectation (NOT measured): the 3 tests in describe "non-operator reader, review naming a foreign tenant in its own schema" fail (context and GET /:id return 200 instead of the 404 baseline bytes; the list contains the review id) and the 2 control tests pass. The first real mix run (TEST-RUNNER / ELIXIR-DEV with a reachable DB) must confirm the 3-red/2-green split and quote it.

REGISTRY (Step 0.5): ISS-1026 (resolved; approve/reject; its follow_ups name this issue; its fix is the pattern to copy), ISS-1021 (context plan allowlist) and ISS-1023 (entries withheld) are resolved predecessors, not recurrences: none touched the read gate. docs/issues has no ISS-1029; the queue issue_ref for Q-1011 is ISS-1011 which collides with local ISS-1011 (SwiftRoute roster), so local id ISS-1029 is kept (cited by ISS-1026 follow_ups and decision 0046 ~L470); no origin branch or queue ref uses 1029.

FIX DESIGN (lib/ in two files; no migration, no new route or response shape)

A. Predicate. Extract the decision core of stored_tenants_authorized?/3 (L678-L696) into a pure private fun review_tenants_authorized?(conn, %PromotionReview{serialised_plan: s}): decode s (non-map or malformed -> %{}), then tenants_authorized?(conn, [plan["source_tenant_id"], plan["target_tenant_id"]]) (L315, i.e. Letflow.Api.TenantTarget.authorize_target_tenant/2: platform_scope? -> :ok, else each id must be a canonical UUID equal to the caller's tenant, case-insensitive). stored_tenants_authorized?/3 becomes get_review + review_tenants_authorized?/2 (and true on :review_not_found), so approve/reject/apply/run-assertions are byte-identical and all seven routes share one predicate. Minimal-diff alternative with equal behaviour: call stored_tenants_authorized?/3 unchanged before the read (one extra get_review per request). Prefer the extraction: one read, no check/render gap.

B. GET /promotions/:id/context (handle_context L526): read the review once; if {:ok, review} and not review_tenants_authorized?(conn, review) -> Response.not_found(conn); else render_context as today. shape_plan/2 stays UNCHANGED (defence in depth, INV-2).

C. GET /promotions/:id (handle_get_assertion_run L487): same gate on the {:ok, review} branch BEFORE Definitions.get_latest_assertion_run is called. Non-UUID and nonexistent ids already take {:error, :review_not_found} -> 404, so all denial causes emit the same Response.not_found(conn) bytes.

D. GET /promotions (handle_list_reviews L1157 + PromotionReviewStore.list_reviews/2). DECISION: OMIT, not placeholder. A placeholder discloses existence, count and ordering of the hidden row and changes the 7-key item contract; omission makes the list indistinguishable from "that review does not exist", which is what the per-review routes now answer. A router-side Enum.filter would break pagination (short pages, wrong next_cursor), and a SQL filter is unsafe (serialised_plan is :text; a ::jsonb cast raises on malformed legacy rows and would 500 the whole list). So filter inside the store's keyset loop:
 - list_reviews/2 takes a new optional opts key :row_visible? (1-arity fun on %PromotionReview{} -> boolean; default nil = no filtering, existing behaviour and store tests unchanged). The router passes fn r -> review_tenants_authorized?(conn, r) end ONLY when tenant_view(conn) != :operator; the operator path is structurally the current one.
 - Algorithm: fetch chunks of page_size + 1 rows with the existing ordering (desc inserted_at, desc id) and keyset seek (status/def_id/def_type filters stay in SQL, applied first), keep rows where row_visible?.(row); continue from the last scanned row until page_size + 1 visible rows are held, or a chunk comes back short (exhausted), or the scan cap is hit (@max_scan_rows 1000 module attribute).
   * >= page_size + 1 visible: page = first page_size, next_cursor = cursor of the LAST EMITTED row (existing build_list_reviews_next_cursor/1).
   * exhausted: page = all visible, next_cursor = nil (a hidden-only remainder gives nil, no false has_more).
   * cap hit with fewer than page_size + 1 visible: page = the visible rows found (may be empty), next_cursor = cursor of the last SCANNED row (non-nil) so the client resumes after it; document in moduledoc and route docs. Foreign-named rows are rare, so the cap is a DoS bound, not a normal path.
 - Cursor format, expiry, wrong_endpoint, invalid_cursor handling unchanged; cursors minted before the fix stay valid (they encode an emitted, hence visible, row).

E. Operator unchanged: the predicate returns :ok for platform_scope? (PLATFORM_ADMIN of the pinned platform tenant) and the list passes no filter.

TEST CHANGES (exact list)
1. Extend test/letflow/routers/promotion_read_stored_ids_test.exs (existing 5 stay): (a) GET /:id with an assertion run present on a foreign-named review answers the 404 baseline bytes, no run id or failing_assertion_ids in the body; (b) non-UUID id on both per-review routes; (c) list with page_size 1 and 2, foreign-named rows interleaved at page boundaries: pages hold only visible ids, union == visible set, no duplicates, last next_cursor nil, hidden-only tail gives nil; (d) status and def_id filters still compose; (e) operator list includes the foreign-named review.
2. test/letflow/definitions/promotion_review_store_test.exs: row_visible? cases (nil unchanged, all hidden, boundary, cap).
3. UPDATE existing tests that assert a non-operator 200 on a foreign-named review (flip to the nonexistent-review 404 bytes, keep operator controls, drop shaping assertions now unreachable for foreign ids):
 - promotion_context_shaping_test.exs (T-8): context_omits_foreign_tenant_ids_for_non_operator (L57, b->a read as A), context_other_keys_and_status_unchanged (L115, b->a). Keep context_unknown_top_level_keys_dropped_and_entries_not_descended (a/a) and context_unchanged_for_operator.
 - promotion_context_allowlist_test.exs (T-11): foreign_side_definition_id_omitted_own_side_kept (L167: cases b/a, a/b, b/b become 404; only a/a stays 200), null_definition_id_omitted_for_foreign_side_kept_for_own_side (L206, b->a), non_map_plan_fails_closed (L221: non-operator half 404, operator half unchanged), legacy_plan_missing_keys (L240: non-operator halves 404, operator halves unchanged), envelope_has_nine_keys_for_both_views (L322: fixture a reads b->a so 404; operator p half stays 200), pin_unset_would_be_operator_is_shaped_like_everyone_else (L336: unpinned p reading b->p, becomes 404), entries_not_a_list_replaced_by_empty_list (L265: seed_and_overwrite! writes a plan with NO tenant ids, so it also becomes 404; flip, or give the JSON own ids to keep the entries check). Unchanged: odd_tenant_keys..., unknown_top_level_key_omitted, entries_kept_exactly_as_stored, non_scalar_under_plain_key_omitted, own_tenant_ids_kept_case_insensitively (a/a), nil_tenant_context_never_reaches_the_handler (500 from Authorize before the handler), operator_sees_all_unchanged.
 - promotion_context_entries_scope_test.exs (T-13): foreign_reviews_entries_are_empty_for_a_non_operator_reader_in_p (L173, B/C, C/B, B/B), one_foreign_side_is_enough_to_withhold_entries (L195: foreign cases 404; P/P control stays 200 with entries), withheld_entries_leave_the_rest_of_the_response_unchanged (L262), legacy_plans_with_missing_or_non_binary_tenant_ids_fail_closed (L292: non-operator 404, operator view unchanged), tenant_admin_of_the_platform_tenant_reads_a_foreign_review_without_entries (L400: 404 pinned and unpinned, operator control unchanged). Unchanged: operator_reads_the_same_foreign_review..., own_tenant_reviews_still_show_entries, own_ids_case_insensitive_keep_entries, the AC5 403 tripwire.
 - promotions_test.exs (REQ-397 list tests; NOT named in the AC but broken by the fix): req397_sample_plan/2 (L375) stamps source_tenant_id: Ecto.UUID.generate() with target = caller's tenant and reads as TENANT_ADMIN (non-operator), so every R12 list test (AC1, AC2, AC3, AC5, response shape, pagination, ~L437-L720) would find its rows omitted. Change the helper to source_tenant_id: tenant_id (own/own); no assertion change.
 - Verified UNAFFECTED (own/own seeds, b/b seeds or operator callers): req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs R3/R4 (default PLATFORM_ADMIN, pinned), req446_cross_tenant_denial_test.exs rows (b/b), tenant_admin_routes_test.exs L149 (a/a), promotion_scope_test.exs (nonexistent uuid).
4. Docs: short note in test/specs/ISS-1021.md and ISS-1023.md that foreign-id shaping is now defence in depth behind the 404; ISS-1029.yaml -> resolved with the real run id; close the decision 0046 ~L470 follow-up.

MUTANTS (each must fail the named tests): M1 gate removed from handle_context -> context repro and flipped T-8/T-11/T-13 tests; M2 gate removed from handle_get_assertion_run -> GET /:id repro and 1(a); M3 list passes no row_visible? -> list repro and 1(c); M4 gate placed after get_latest_assertion_run (same bytes, side effect) -> only caught if 1(a) asserts no run read, so keep a test that the assertion-run lookup is not reached (e.g. a run row whose lookup would raise or a count); M5 predicate uses `or` over the two ids -> one_foreign_side_is_enough, B/C cases; M6 operator also filtered -> operator list/context controls; M7 placeholder instead of omit -> list repro; M8 next_cursor from last scanned on a full page -> 1(c) duplicates/skips; M9 filter after the page cut (router-side Enum.filter) -> 1(c) short-page assertions; M10 predicate fails open on a malformed plan -> legacy cases.

RISKS: (R1) shape_plan/2 foreign branches become dead for non-operators through the route; kept deliberately (defence in depth, operator-with-pin-unset); deleting them is a separate change. (R2) empty page with non-nil next_cursor when the scan cap is hit; a client that stops on an empty page misses later rows (rare, documented); dropping the cap was rejected as a DoS surface. (R3) per-row JSON decode inside the scan: bounded by the cap, non-operators only. (R4) a review the caller legitimately created as operator in its own schema naming foreign tenants becomes invisible to that caller once it is no longer an operator; intended and consistent with approve/reject/apply. (R5) ordering vs REQ-447: this lands before :PromotionsRead goes to TENANT_ADMIN/TENANT_AUDITOR, the intended order. (R6) SECURITY-REVIEWER gate is required (tenant-data path, INV-10), AC6.

ROUTING: size S3 and fully specified, so CODE-DESIGNER may write only a short design (lib/letflow/design/iss1029-read-stored-ids.md) -> CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR -> ELIXIR-DEV (promotions.ex, promotion_review_store.ex) + TEST-DESIGNER (tests above) -> SECURITY-REVIEWER -> REVIEWER -> TEST-RUNNER (needs a reachable DB; see REPRO STATUS) -> RELEASE-VALIDATOR.
